lines.text: Can freeze all transfers (pause(), paused(), unpause()). Nobody may be able to sell.

Public source code that Sourcify confirmed matches the on-chain code (FlowerOFT, Solidity, 0.8.22+commit.4fc1097e). Read it at https://repo.sourcify.dev/8453/0x3e12b9d6a4d12cd9b4a6d613872d0eb32f68b380

A simulated buy and sell of a small amount through Uniswap V2 worked (tax: 0% buy, 0% sell). This is a test at the current block only: whoever controls the contract may still raise the tax or block selling later.
